gates.name: Test
gates.detail: dotnet test --no-build --configuration Release --verbosity normal: Total tests: 363, Passed: 363, Failed: 0. Test Run Successful.

gates.name: Run the sample in both roles
gates.reason: build/Test-SampleRoundTrip.ps1 is documented and written as Linux-only (SIGTERM via P/Invoke to libc's kill(2), sqlite3 CLI). This worktree is Windows (MINGW64_NT-10.0-26200); the corresponding CI check on the pull request is where the answer will come from.

gates.name: Assert no framework project references a workload
gates.detail: pwsh ./build/Test-WorkloadIsolation.ps1: No project under src/ or samples/ references workloads/ (28 project file(s) checked).

gates.name: Typecheck
gates.detail: cd workloads/game-service && npm run typecheck -> tsc --noEmit completed with no errors and no output.

gates.name: Start the workload and the edge, the documented way
gates.detail: Started game-service on 127.0.0.1:8080 (npm start) and GameEdge on 127.0.0.1:5080 fronting it. curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/livez -> {"status":"healthy"}; /readyz -> {"status":"healthy"}; curl http://127.0.0.1:5080/health/live -> {"status":"Healthy","checks":[]}; /health/ready -> {"status":"Healthy","checks":[{"name":"game-workload","status":"Healthy"},{"name":"platform.audit.sink","status":"Healthy"}]}.

gates.name: Run the replay against the workload
gates.detail: npx vitest run tests/replay.test.ts: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 11 passed (11). Includes S5.2/S5.3 byte-identity proof and S5.7/S5.9 assertions.

gates.name: Run the replay against the edge
gates.detail: GAME_EDGE_DLL=<built edge dll> npx vitest run tests/replay-edge.test.ts: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 2 passed (2). S7.8 byte-identity proof through the edge.

gates.name: Migrate the schema to head, the documented way
gates.detail: GAME_SERVICE_DB_SCHEMA=ci_documented_migrate npm run migrate (against a locally provisioned postgres:17 container standing in for docker-compose.yml's postgres on an alternate host port, 5433, because 5432 was already bound by an unrelated running container from another repository -- see reason on the below three gates for detail): tsx scripts/migrate.ts -> 'migrated ci_documented_migrate to head'.

gates.name: Start the workload against the durable store, the documented way
gates.detail: GAME_SERVICE_PORT=8081 GAME_SERVICE_STORAGE=durable GAME_SERVICE_DB_SCHEMA=ci_documented_durable_start npm start (against the same alternate-port postgres) then curl http://127.0.0.1:8081/readyz -> {"status":"healthy"}.

gates.name: Run the one-instance contention proof
gates.detail: npx vitest run tests/contention-one-instance.test.ts (GAME_SERVICE_TEST_DATABASE_URL pointed at the alternate-port postgres): Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 5 passed (5).

gates.name: Run the two-instance contention proof
gates.detail: npx vitest run tests/contention-two-instances.test.ts (alternate-port postgres): Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 7 passed (7).

gates.name: Run the durable replay
gates.detail: npx vitest run tests/durable-replay.test.ts (alternate-port postgres): Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 7 passed (7). S8.2/S8.3/S8.4/S8.6/S8.9 byte-identity and schema-isolation proofs.

gates.name: Run the port-conformance suite
gates.detail: npx vitest run tests/conformance.test.ts (alternate-port postgres): Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 7 passed (7).

gates.name: Test (game-service)
gates.detail: GAME_EDGE_DLL=<built edge dll> npm test (OTEL_COLLECTOR_BIN not set; alternate-port postgres): Test Files 24 passed | 1 skipped (25), Tests 197 passed | 1 skipped (198). The skipped file is tests/trace-evidence.test.ts, which gracefully skips without an OpenTelemetry Collector binary available.
